address: Galerie de la Reine 30, Brussels, 1000, Belgium
bio: This emblematic Art deco brasserie, which is housed in the exclusive Galerie du roi, just a stone’s throw from the iconic Grand Place, takes you back in time to the Roaring Twenties. Its vintage charm is enhanced by a host of elegant details like the golden origami birds. The equally nostalgic menu offers a splendid lineup of Belgian family favourites: crunchy shrimp fritters, sole meunière with fresh French fries, warm chocolate mousse with butterscotch ice cream. Living proof that tradition and generosity are timeless values!...
